paragraphs: Rava son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna. Sotah 49a: Rav Huna found an aromatic date. His son Rabbah came, and Rabbah said, ‘I smell an aromatic date on you.’ He told him, ‘My son, there is purity in you’—therefore you can smell it, since when purity ceased in Israel, fruit lost its flavor and fragrance. He gave it to him. Meanwhile Rava, Rabbah bar Rav Huna's son, came; he took it and gave it to him. Rav Huna told his son Rabbah, ‘You have gladdened my heart’—with your purity—‘and set my teeth on edge’—by showing that you love your son more than me, taking it from me and giving it to him. Hullin 76a: where is the junction of the sinews? Rabbah said that Rav Ashi said, etc.; Rabbah bar Rav Huna said that Rav Ashi said, etc.; Rava son of Rabbah בר״ס [transmitted patronymic unresolved] said that Rav Assi said, etc. Eruvin 55b: Rabbah bar Rav Huna said, etc.; Rava son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna said, etc. Abaye said, ‘Rava son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna's view appears reasonable.’
